projects.title: Building a more intentional digital presence
projects.image_alt: Media brand case study visual placeholder
projects.summary: A media and commentary brand supported across multiple social platforms, with a focus on content direction, consistency and learning from performance.

sections.heading: The context
sections.body: The brand needed consistent publishing and a clearer understanding of which content formats and topics were connecting with its audience.

sections.heading: My contribution
sections.body: Social media management, content coordination, caption development, platform publishing, performance monitoring and monthly reporting. Replace this summary with the exact platforms, dates and responsibilities you personally handled.

sections.heading: The thinking
sections.body: I paid attention to how different topics performed across platforms, identified stronger audience responses and used those observations to inform content recommendations.

sections.heading: Evidence & outcomes
sections.body: Add approved platform screenshots, links to published posts and the original reporting period. One previously reported Facebook post reached 69.8K views, and a reported YouTube period recorded +532 subscribers. Verify dates and attribution before publishing these figures.

sections.heading: What I'd improve next
sections.body: Build a repeatable content testing rhythm, connect each content pillar to a clear audience need and use reporting to guide the next month's creative decisions.

projects.note: Client work. Confirm the client name, permission to display assets and exact reporting dates before publishing.

projects.title: Creating a consistent brand voice
projects.summary: Supporting fashion and lifestyle brands with content execution and social media communication that feels recognisable, relevant and aligned with the brand.

sections.heading: The context
sections.body: A fashion brand needs a steady stream of content that communicates product value, gives customers useful information and keeps the brand present between promotions.

sections.heading: My contribution
sections.body: Add the exact account, platforms, content formats and dates you managed. Potential evidence includes content calendars, approved captions, campaign posts and community engagement examples.

sections.heading: The creative approach
sections.body: Show how you translated product details into customer-facing messages, balanced promotional and non-promotional content and maintained consistency.

sections.heading: Evidence & outcomes
sections.body: Replace this section with real content examples, reach or engagement figures and client feedback. Do not add metrics unless you can verify them.

sections.heading: What I'd improve next
sections.body: Use recurring content formats, customer questions and product education to build a more useful content mix.

projects.note: Client work. Add only approved brand materials and results that can be attributed to your work.

projects.title: Making onboarding feel clear and human
projects.summary: Helping a digital community move from first contact to confident participation through clear communication, structured onboarding and responsive support.

sections.heading: The context
sections.body: A growing digital community needs clear entry points, consistent information and a dependable way to handle questions as new people join.

sections.heading: My contribution
sections.body: Your experience included welcoming and onboarding participants, explaining processes, responding to questions, supporting training sessions, tracking participant progress and escalating issues when needed.

sections.heading: The approach
sections.body: Keep instructions simple, repeat essential information in accessible formats, guide people to the right next step and maintain a calm, helpful tone when questions arise.

sections.heading: Evidence & outcomes
sections.body: Add anonymised screenshots of onboarding messages, training materials, FAQs, community guidelines and any verified participant or response-volume figures.

sections.heading: What I'd improve next
sections.body: Create a searchable knowledge base, standardise recurring answers and build a simple tracking process for unresolved questions.

projects.note: Anonymise participant details and remove private conversations, phone numbers, account identifiers and financial information.

projects.title: A launch campaign built around a real audience need
projects.summary: A demonstration project showing how I move from audience insight to campaign message, content formats and a practical publishing plan.

sections.heading: The brief
sections.body: Create a launch campaign for a fictional Nigerian skincare brand introducing a simple daily routine for busy customers.

sections.heading: Audience insight
sections.body: The audience wants a routine that feels manageable, clear and worth the money. They need product education before they need another promotional message.

sections.heading: Campaign idea
sections.body: A seven-day 'make room for your routine' content series built around one useful product question each day.

sections.heading: Sample deliverables
sections.body: Short-form video scripts, carousel outlines, creator brief, caption bank, publishing schedule and a sample paid-social creative.

sections.heading: Measurement plan
sections.body: Track video retention, saves, product-page clicks, qualified enquiries and conversion. These are proposed measures, not campaign results.

projects.note: Self-initiated concept project. This is not a campaign commissioned by or run for a real client.

projects.title: Building a practical starting point for aspiring social media managers
projects.summary: A beginner-focused learning product created to help aspiring social media managers understand the foundations of the role and begin practising with structure.

sections.heading: The idea
sections.body: I wanted to turn practical social media management knowledge into a clear starting point for people who are curious about the field but do not know where to begin.

sections.heading: What I built
sections.body: A self-paced learning experience with structured video lessons, practical templates and a 90-day implementation phase designed to help learners move from understanding concepts to applying them.

sections.heading: The experience behind it
sections.body: This project brings together my experience as a social media practitioner, content strategist and educator. It also demonstrates curriculum planning, information design, audience understanding and learner experience.

sections.heading: Evidence to add
sections.body: Add approved screenshots of the programme, lesson previews, template samples, learner feedback and any verified enrolment or completion figures when available.

sections.heading: Why it belongs in my portfolio
sections.body: It shows that I do not only execute social media work for brands. I can also develop a learning product, organise information and create practical resources for a defined audience.

projects.note: Founder-created programme. Add actual product visuals and learner feedback only when approved and available. Do not imply learner outcomes or sales figures without evidence.

projects.title: A thoughtful support journey from first message to resolution
projects.summary: A sample customer-support workflow designed to make responses more consistent while keeping the experience personal and useful.

sections.heading: The scenario
sections.body: A customer has paid for a digital service but cannot access their account. They have already contacted the business once and are frustrated.

sections.heading: The response principles
sections.body: Acknowledge the inconvenience, confirm the relevant details safely, explain the next step and set a realistic expectation for follow-up.

sections.heading: The workflow
sections.body: Receive and categorise the enquiry, verify the issue without requesting sensitive credentials, resolve or escalate, confirm the outcome and record the case.

sections.heading: Sample assets
sections.body: Add an anonymised ticket example, response templates, escalation matrix, FAQ and a simple support tracker.

sections.heading: Success measures
sections.body: Track first response time, resolution time, reopened tickets, customer satisfaction and recurring issue themes.

projects.note: Self-initiated concept project. The workflow is illustrative and should be adapted to each company's policies and tools.

site_copy.hero_intro: I'm Vivian Igbokwe, a social media & content strategist and customer experience specialist with 3+ years of experience helping brands show up with clarity, creativity and consistency.
site_copy.intro_statement: I bring the ideas, the execution and the human touch. From scroll-stopping content to customer conversations, I help brands create digital experiences people remember.
site_copy.approach_intro: I like work that looks good, makes sense and serves a real purpose. My process is collaborative, curious and grounded in what the audience actually needs.
site_copy.about_lead: A curious communicator with a soft spot for good stories, thoughtful systems and work that makes people's lives a little easier.
site_copy.about_paragraph_1: My background is in English Language and Education, and I bring 3+ years of hands-on experience across social media management, content creation, community management and customer support. I have worked with clients, teams and online communities across different time zones, adapting communication, handovers and delivery to keep work moving. I am comfortable with remote collaboration and asynchronous workflows. I've supported brands and digital communities, helped people navigate products and processes, and created content designed to connect with real audiences.
site_copy.about_paragraph_2: I enjoy the balance between creative thinking and practical execution: understanding what needs to happen, figuring out how to make it happen, and paying attention to the people on the other side.
site_copy.zero_to_smm_intro: Zero to SMM Starter Pack is my beginner-friendly learning product designed to help aspiring social media managers understand the foundations of the work and start practising with more confidence. It brings together structured lessons, practical templates and an implementation pathway.
site_copy.contact_intro: Have a project, a growing team or a business that could use thoughtful creative and customer experience support? I'd love to hear what you're working on.
site_copy.hero_eyebrow: SOCIAL MEDIA · CREATIVE STRATEGY · CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE
